rationale: Reorders the existing single sentence into a bulleted list and explicitly elevates the tracked-.gitignore-and-commit action with the phrase "Before anything else," placing it ahead of the worktree-creation bullet. Mechanism is emphasis-via-reordering rather than a numbered procedure (candidate 1) or a named gate (candidate 2), making it materially distinct. The directory-precedence rules and the no-overwrite and baseline-test requirements are preserved verbatim.
expected_effect: By placing the commit-first obligation in its own bullet immediately before the creation bullet and explicitly naming `.git/info/exclude` as insufficient, the agent should commit the `.worktrees/` rule to tracked `.gitignore` before `git worktree add`, satisfying HEAD:.gitignore verification on `default-hidden`.
regression_risk: Low. The bullet form is closer to the original prose than the numbered or gated forms, so behavior on reliable tasks should be unchanged; the only added action is the tracked-commit step, which is idempotent when the rule already exists. Slight residual risk if the agent treats "Before anything else" as overriding the directory-selection bullet, but selection is listed first to prevent that.
